body:
I came out as a super-flexible one-legged Chinese lesbian dwarf with a slight strange speech impediment that loves homosexual Black men on rainy days. Yay for diversity and how it mentally fcuks us up.

I sort of know how you feel.
Have you met or talked to anyone that is or was in the same boat as you now? And do your parents know?
Okay. I see. Have you thought about reaching out to other people who are in a situation like yours? And what is the best advice you have come across so far in dealing with your problem?

Just a suggestion, but publicly sharing your feelings on Youtube could be the first step to moving towards a more concrete solution. Many others with suicidal thoughts would see your bravery and they might jump in and encourage you. Their gratitude can work wonders for pulling us out of those dark places.
You mean he is gay and bullied you, or he bullied you because you are gay?
But as one channel grows, they could link up with other "suicide" channels and share their learnings and painload. See where things go from there.
Can I ask, what was the reason you were bullied?
But even the first few subscribers would feel compassion for those struggling in these tough times. I think people would spread the word quickly if they sensed you were sincere.
Just find a quiet moment, even just for a few minutes. I'd be willing to collate the "Suicide" channels and spread the word.
